text:
anya: Heads-up: opened PR to add a tenant-attribution section to the quotas doc. It shows how to map requests to billing_tiers and how the dashboard panels reflect per-tenant usage. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1299

anya: The motivation: customers keep asking how to attribute shared endpoints to internal teams + avoid double-counting when proxying through our gateway. I added two snippets (curl + python-sdk) and a short migration note for users moving from the old `plan_id` mapping to the new `billing_tier` label.

ben: skimmed it. please add a tiny diagram or ascii sketch showing ingress -> attribution -> meter. non-dev readers find that helpful. also call out edge-case: requests with missing tenant header => fallback to `anonymous` bucket.

rachel: billing QA: liking the approach. A few asks: 1) show example pricing lookup code (pricing tiers are on /pricing but we should show how to pull programmatically), 2) clarify rounding rules (we round up to nearest token, but the UI shows aggregated totals), 3) do not publish sample API keys in curl (use {API_KEY}).

priya: docs note: for the python snippet please use our canonical client import path `from redwood import RedwoodClient` and prefer keyword args for clarity. Also please add a short test matrix entry in the PR checklist (python 3.10/3.11 + node 18).

anya: pushing updates: replaced diagram with simple ascii, switched to {API_KEY} placeholder, added a pricing lookup example, and added the test matrix checklist item. snippets below: 

anya: ```bash
# curl example (tenant attribution header)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {API_KEY}" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: team-alpha" \
  -d '{"prompt":"summarize this"}'
```

anya: ```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="{API_KEY}")
usage = client.usage.latest(model="redwood-3b", tenant_id="team-alpha")
# look up pricing per token
pricing = client.pricing.get(tier=usage.billing_tier)
estimated = usage.total_tokens * pricing.per_token
print(f"tenant={usage.tenant_id} tokens={usage.total_tokens} est_cost={estimated:.4f}")
```

ben: small nit: method names should match runtime (usage.latest -> usage.get_latest). please update.

rachel: also add a one-liner about multi-tenant dashboards: link to panel `panel-multitenant-1` and note that panels default to last-30d. mention that admin users can change scope via the project dropdown.

docbot: docs-ci: build warning: broken anchor `#billing_tier-mapping` in docs/quotas.md: line 142. See https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/1299/warnings

anya: thanks docbot. I fixed the anchor and pushed. also added the panel link. pushed again.

priya: LGTM for docs style. one more accessibility note: include alt text for the ascii diagram in the md file for screen readers.

dan: security check: tenant header `X-Redwood-Tenant` must be validated server-side and cannot be trusted from client requests for enterprise accounts. Added a short sentence to say server should reconcile with auth identity.

rachel: billing acked the updated rounding note. Also verified pricing lookup snippet uses `pricing.per_token` var name.

anya: CI is now green. plan to merge on Monday 9am PT if no objections. tagging @ben for final method-name patch.

ben: pushed the method-name fix and small test addition. all green from me, feel free to merge Monday.

anya: thanks all :party_parrot:
